p: my servant: That is, Christ, who in respect to his manhood is called here servant. The prophets used to make mention of Christ after they declared any great promise, because he is the foundation on which all the promises are made and ratified.
whom I uphold: For I have committed all my power to him, as to a most faithful steward: some read, I will establish him: that is, in his office by giving him the fulness of my Spirit.
delighteth: Only he is acceptable to me and they that come to me by him: for there is no other means of reconciliation, Mt 12:18, Eph 4:1
judgment to the Gentiles: He will declare himself governor over the Gentiles and call them by his word, and rule them by his Spirit.
cry: His coming will not be with pomp and noise, as earthly princes.
bruised reed shall he not break: He will not hurt the weak and feeble, but support and comfort them.
flax shall he not quench: Meaning, the wick of a lamp or candle which is almost out, but he will cherish it and snuff it, that it may shine brighter.
truth: Although he favours the weak, yet will he not spare the wicked, but will judge them according to truth and equity.
set judgment in the earth: Till he has set all things in good order.
isles shall wait for his law: The Gentiles will desire to receive his doctrine.
righteousness: Meaning, to a lawful and just calling.
thy hand: To assist and guide you.
covenant of the people: As him, by whom the promise made to all nations in Abraham will be fulfilled.
glory will I not give to: I will not permit my glory to be diminished: which I would do if I were not faithful.
come to pass: As in time past I have been true in my promises, so will I be in time to come.
Kedar doth inhabit: Meaning, the Arabians, under whom he comprehends all the people of the East.
mighty man: He shows the zeal of the Lord, and his power in the conservation of his Church.
travailing woman: I will haste to execute my vengeance, which I have so long deferred as a woman that desires to be delivered, when she is in labour.
blind by a way that they: That is, my poor people, who are in perplexity and care.
servant: That is, Israel, which would have most light because of my Law.
messenger that I sent: The priest to whom my word is committed, who would not only hear it himself but cause others to hear it.
perfect: As the priests and prophets that would be lights to others?

robbed and plundered: Because they will not acknowledge this blessing from the Lord, who is ready to deliver them, he permits them to be spoiled by their enemies through their own fault and incredulity.
Restore: There will be no one to comfort them, or to will the enemy to restore that which he has spoiled.
the time to come: Meaning, God's wrath.
